A writer wrote steamy adult stories starring a Demon King. Now he wants justice! In order to avoid execution, the writer must make half of the contents of her novel, a collection of lust and desire, come true! But wait, she is supposed to re-enact all the scenes, as the female lead, while the Demon King acts out the male lead? Living in a world of demons, caught by its monarch, and engaged in steamy role play! Let the games begin!

---
I hit it big with an erotica novel starring the demon lord, but then got sued by the real demon lord! I need to turn at least half the novel into reality to survive. The smut novel *Sungwoon Lim’s 5,500 Shadows* needs to become reality!

Irene Yoo, whose life ended just as it began to bloom at nineteen, spent her second life as a virgin ghost full of yin* energy in the underworld. She made the most of her benefits after turning into a succubus and granted permission to live in the Demon World.

‘I was going to teach that innocent, workaholic Demon Lord these kind of things, that kind of things, and also those things, but-'

“That’s not much. Close your eyes. Let’s finish quickly.”

“I… I have my preferences too!”

“I think I know your preferences better than you do.”

The Demon Lord memorized the erotica I wrote in one night. Furthermore, what is with this pervy ‘progress chart’?!

When I told him that I can’t lose my virginity to someone I don’t have feelings for, the Demon Lord, Claude Stern, asked as he undid the buttons of his shirt, “You don’t have any feelings for me?”

Your Majesty, why are you deepening your voice? Why are you closing the distance between us?!

Написав эротический роман с Лордом Демонов в главной роли, я получила судебный иск от настоящего Владыки Демонов. Чтобы выжить, мне нужно доказать, что хотя бы половина написанного в ней - правда.
Эротический роман «5500 теней Лорда Демона» должен стать правдой!

Айрин Ю, жизнь которой закончилась ровно тогда, когда и началась, в 19 лет. Имея внутри себя огромное количество энергии Инь, и живя в загробном мире, как девственный дух, она решила воспользоваться своим положением по полной, и получила признание от владыки демонов, разрешившему ей жить в мире демонов, и превратив в суккуба.

— Я хотела научить этого Владыку трудоголика вот такому, такому и даже вот такому, но…
— У… У меня есть и свои предпочтения!
— И их я знаю их лучше вас.

Владыка демонов цитировал мною написанный эротический роман. Но что за извращённое развитие событий?!

Когда я сказала, что не хочу терять девственность с тем, к кому не испытываю никаких чувств, Владыка Демонов, Клауд Штерн, расстёгивая пуговицы рубашки, спросил:
— Так вы ничего не испытываете ко мне?
— Ваше величество, почему вы сказали это шёпотом? Зачем вы подходите ещё ближе?!

Javotte Wincheston hat für die Männer, die ihrer jüngeren Stiefschwester anzüglich hinterherstarren, nichts als böse Blicke übrig. Ja, es stimmt schon, dass sie sich in der Vergangenheit nicht wirklich um Cinciarell gekümmert hat. Aber seit diese sie mit einem Schlag wie durch ein Wunder aus dem Koma erweckt hat, ist sie ihr ans Herz gewachsen. Javotte ist nun fest entschlossen, ihrer Rolle als Erbin von Haus Wincheston gerecht zu werden und die wahre Herrin des Hauses zu werden. Mit der Hilfe ihres neuen, mysteriösen Liebhabers aus dem nahe gelegenen Kaiserreich versucht sie, das sterbende Familienunternehmen wiederzubeleben. Doch ihre Mutter, die immer so wohlwollend und fürsorglich war, scheint nicht die Absicht zu haben, das zuzulassen. description.en:
At the age of 19, I, Zabotte Winchester, inherited the legacy of my stepfather and became the owner of the Winchester family. I thought my mother would run the family, so I could live a comfortable life. When I found out I might die from a car accident, I rewrote my life plan.

"From now on, I will be the real owner of Winchester."

I will protect Winchester's wealth and honor, the future of my old and new sisters, and win the loyalty of a man who was the start the night at a ball all by himself.

"Miss Winchester, I will only tell you. Actually, my real identity…"

"Shh. Keep your secret, Merrick. The only thing I care about is a man's kind heart.”

“…But why have you been touching my thigh since a while ago?"

"Don't get me wrong. I was exploring where the man's heart comes from."

She has a little temper, but it turns out she's a caring older sister.

---
Javotte Wincheston shoots a venomous glare at the men leering at Cinciarell in the ballroom. Yes, it's true that she didn't really care for her younger stepsister in the past. But ever since Cinciarell miraculously woke her up from a coma by body slamming her, Javotte has had a soft spot for her stepsister. Javotte is now determined to step up as House Wincheston's heir and become the true head of the household. With the help of her new, mysterious lover from the empire, she struggles to find ways to revive the dying family business. But her mother, who has always been so benevolent and caring, seems to have no intention of letting that happen. Will Javotte be able to restore the Wincheston name to its former glory and find out what sort of secrets her mother is hiding?

description.en:
I possessed a character in the novel I had been writing roughly for a year: A wicked woman who was destined to die horribly within the next two years.  
  
‘Is this the price for making the readers suffer?’  
  
Anyway, the male lead was suffering from rolling over like a hoop. For the welfare of my creation, the poor male lead, and for my survival, I got a job at the mansion as a maid. And now…  
  
“Lady Laria is the best, after all. I want you to be the mistress of the Blackwell Grand Duchy.”  
  
“Laria is the best!”  
  
“Laria, like my mother?”  
  
The whole family of the Grand Duke likes me. Even the Grand Duke is obsessed with me, performing all sorts of tricks…  
  
“The Lady and I are engaged.”  
  
Yes? Since when?  
  
“My children and I need Lady Sherwood. I have no intention of letting her go.”

나 때문에 기구한 운명을 갖게 된 남주의 복지를 위해서,
아이들과의 관계를 개선하고 여주와의 해피엔딩도 이뤄 주겠어!

男主因為我才有了這麼曲折的命運，為了改變這一切，我要讓他改善與孩子們的關係，和女主有一個幸福結局！

‘拉里婭最好了！什麼時候當我們的媽媽啊？ ’“希望小姐成為大公家的女主人！”…可是事情好像開始偏離預定軌道！

Instead of being enrolled at her high school she was supposed to be in, she got enrolled to Youngsol High. And with that Hana anticipate her new start.  
  
However, she ends up being an outsider on the first day of transfer and even ran into a scary male student…!

As a successful captain in the military, Lee Yoon-ah is an icon of success and power.  But after an accident on the battlefield, she finds herself trapped in a romantic fantasy novel!

Stuck in a supporting role as the best friend to the main protagonist, Yoon-ah is determined to overturn the plotline and change Rosalie’s fate. Will she be able to change Rosalie’s fate and find happiness in the new world? 

Will she return to where she was originally from?
description.fr:
Lee Yoon-Ah, capitaine d'une unité des forces spéciales, considérée comme la meilleure de Corée.

En tant que soldat, il n’y avait pas de romance dans sa vie. Cependant, un monde complètement différent se déroule devant elle, après avoir perdue sa tête à cause d'un bombardement lors de son expédition à l’étranger.

Elle se retrouve dans un roman d’amour fantastique écrit par son ami !
Elle devient alors « Rosalie », une femme qui vit une vie misérable.

Prenant une profonde respiration et se tenant la tête un moment, elle décida de changer sa vie, considérant cet endroit comme un nouveau champ de bataille.

« C’est une société hiérarchique, et j’ai suffisamment vécue dans une société hiérarchique appelée l’armée que j'en ai marre. »
« Désobéissez-vous à mes ordres maintenant ? »

Elle rencontre alors un homme possédant un charisme absolu !
Mais involontairement, une romance s'installe...

« Duchesse, que pensez-vous de faire agenouiller le prince héritier ? »
« C’est la première fois que je m'agenouille devant quelqu’un d’autre que l’empereur. »

Le personnage masculin original se met à genoux, et non pour l'héroïne.
L'ancienne capitaine, qui ne se soucie pas de l’amour, pourra-t-elle gagner cette bataille ?
description.ko:

뼛속까지 군인인 그녀의 인생에 로맨스 따위는 없었다.
 
그러나 해외파병 중 포탄을 맞고 정신을 잃은 그녀 앞에 전혀 다른 세상이 펼쳐진다.
 
친구가 쓴 로맨스 판타지 소설에 빙의된 것!
그것도 비루한 삶을 살아가는 엑스트라 '로잘리'가 되어.
 
깊은 한숨을 내쉬며 머리를 짚는 것도 잠깐, 그녀는 이곳을 전쟁터라 여기고 삶을 바꾸기로 한다.
 
"여긴 계급사회지. 내가 군대라는 계급사회는 질릴 정도로 체험을 했거든."
 
절대적 카리스마로 공작가를 정복해나가는 대위님!
하지만 의도치 않게 로맨스까지 휘어잡게 되는데….
 
"공작, 황태자를 꿇린 소감이 어때? 황제 폐하를 제외하고 처음으로 누군가한테 무릎 꿇은 건데."
 
원작 남주인공은 여주인공이 아닌 그녀에게 무릎까지 꿇는다.
사랑은 안중에도 없었던 대위님, 이번 전쟁터에서도 승리할 수 있을까?

No entanto, um mundo completamente diferente se desenrola diante dela, que enlouqueceu após ser atingida por um projétil enquanto era despachada para o exterior. Ser possuído por um romance de fantasia escrito por um amigo! Ela também se torna uma 'Rosalie' extra que vive uma vida miserável. Respirando fundo e balançando a cabeça por um momento, ela considera isso um campo de batalha e decide mudar de vida. “Esta é uma sociedade de classes.” “Porque já experimentei o suficiente para me cansar de uma sociedade hierárquica chamada militar.” "Você está desobedecendo minhas ordens agora?" Capitão que conquista o duque com carisma absoluto! No entanto, ela involuntariamente agarra o romance ... “Duke, como é se ajoelhar para o príncipe herdeiro? É a primeira vez que você se ajoelha diante de alguém que não seja o imperador. O protagonista masculino original, não o protagonista feminino, cai de joelhos. Ever since Kang Seol was a child, he's had strange dreams where he and several people wear masks while playing "World of Eternity," a board game full of quests and adventures. And although Seol was great at the game, he was never able to win. But now, his dreams have become reality, and humans have become game pieces!

Humanity's only hope is for Seol to recall what he did in his dreams to survive. Even though he's never won, will he be able to turn the tables and finally make his way to victory?

description.en:
Calypso has experienced repeated reincarnation, and this is her 4th reincarnation. 

In her previous lives, she always died before she reached the age of 22 and returned to where everything started. During her 3rd life, she discovered that when a dragon goes on a rampage, it distorts dimensions. 

Determined to use this knowledge, she plans to exploit the dragon’s power to return to her original world. Currently, Calypso finds herself in a childcare story, where she encounters a man who she believes to be her father but the latter doesn’t recognize her. 

Seeking his help, Calypso involves her "father" and family in her quest, turning them into unwitting allies in her journey.

---
At age 3, Calypso Aquasiadel is the most outstanding genius her family's ever seen, and no wonder... She's actually a modern girl who's been reborn into the same novel thrice! This time around, Calypso's determined to harness the powers of the mysterious dragon duke and send herself back home. The only problem is, she'll first need to earn the respect of her hardened family to survive until then! Can Calypso win their approval and even their hearts? Or is this life doomed for another do-over?
description.es-la:
Un día, un niño pequeño apareció ante mí. “¿Sabes dónde está la academia? ¡Tengo que ir ahí! “ “Has estado yendo en la dirección equivocada todo este tiempo. “ ” !!! “ “¿Qué está mirando, señor?” Supongo que esta es mi hija. "¿Quieres uno?" Pero no creo que ella sepa que soy su padre... Probablemente estés pensando eso, ¿verdad? ¡Si crees eso, estás equivocado, papá! Mi nombre es Calypso, un regresor cuatro veces. Mi vida se arruinó cuando poseí un personaje de novela. ¡Incluso tuve un hijo! ¡El tercer episodio de mi vida fue un final de masacre! '¡Ustedes XX chicos que están locos por esta protagonista femenina!' Sin embargo, por alguna razón, no importa lo que haga, no puedo pasar de mi cumpleaños número 22 y regresar a mi mundo. 
Sin embargo, accidentalmente encontré una manera en la tercera partida cuando el dragón se salió de control y murió. Cuando el dragón corre desenfrenado, ¡la dimensión se distorsiona! ¿Puedo volver a la casa en la que viví durante eso? La cuarta vez, cuando regresé nuevamente, decidí usar este dragón. ¿Abby? ¿Hermanos mayores? ¡Todo es solo un trampolín para encontrarte con el dragón! "¡Espera, dragón!" [Quiero morir ahora, pero me estoy volviendo loco con todos estos retornos repetidos.] [Mi familia está ligada a la familia real] [¿Alguien ha oído hablar alguna vez de los débiles?/ Sólo los más fuertes son felices]

description.en:
An alternate retelling of Snow White with a reincarnated stepmother…  
  
I managed to get myself thrown into a story as a stepmother so jealous of her daughter that she tried to kill the girl with a poisoned apple. I’d love it if I could shower my cute and lovely Blanche with all sorts of affection, but–  
  
“Hilarious. Since when did you like Blanche so much?”  
  
This god-damned husband keeps getting in my way!  
  
“I am Blanche’s parent as well. I demand an apology for being so suspicious of me.”  
  
“And if I don’t?”  
  
“I’ll visit your bedroom tonight, your majesty.”  
  
“…..”  
  
“I even managed to get some really sexy panties just for you.”  
  
With a big smile on my face, I struck him with a critical hit.  
  
“I could show it to you right now if you’d like?”  
  
The look on his face was truly something to behold.  
  
I lifted my chin, and looked down on him victoriously.

ー А если я откажусь?  
ー Сегодня вечером ждите меня в своей спальне, Ваше Величество.

description.de: Ich wurde als Mischling geboren und wurde von meinem Grossvater misshandelt, bis ich starb, weil ich ein nutzloses Kind war, das es nicht schaffte, die besonderen Fähigkeiten meiner Familie zu entwickeln. Zwar kehrte ich mit meinen Erinnerungen in die Vergangenheit zurück, doch meine Möglichkeiten waren begrenzt. Ich könnte so weiterleben und wieder sterben, oder ich könnte meinen Vater suchen, der mich hasste. „Ich will nicht wieder sterben!“ Also machte ich mich auf zu meinem hasserfüllten Vater mit einem Medaillon, das beweisen sollte, dass ich eine Tochter der Schwarzen Panther bin. „Lasst… lasst mich bitte hier leben.“ Ich brauche Schutz, bis ich erwachsen bin. Mein Plan war es, zu gehen und alleine zu leben, sobald ich alt genug bin. Weil ich so ein nutzloses Kind bin. Aber… „Meine geliebte Tochter, wenn dich jemand auch nur anrührt, schneide ich ihm sofort die Kehle durch.“ Mein Vater, von dem ich annahm, dass er mich hasst, war so nett zu mir. „Hey, Ferdi. Heb Tiell nicht ständig so plötzlich hoch. Ich habe dir doch gesagt, dass man mit Mädchen vorsichtig umgehen muss.“ „Wo hast du denn den Mist gehört? Tiell mag es, umarmt zu werden.“ Die grossen Brüder, die mir Angst gemacht haben, mögen mich tatsächlich fast zu sehr. „Tiell, ich denke darüber nach, dich zum nächsten Familienoberhaupt der schwarzen Panther zu machen.“ Mein Grossvater will mich plötzlich zur Haupterbin machen. Hey… solltet ihr mich nicht eigentlich alle hassen?
description.en: The child of a black leopard and a snow leopard shapeshifter, 7-year-old Tiel escapes her abusive family to seek refuge with the father she never knew. All she wants is safety, but her father, the feared Duke Asterian, has other plans... to give his long-lost daughter a loving family and a wonderful home! Now, Tiel is set on protecting her family from the evil forces who want to take her away. Can she fight these foes to save her new home? Or will Tiel lose her loved ones once and for all?
description.fr:
Fille d'un léopard noir et d'une métamorphe léopard des neiges, Tiel, âgée de 7 ans, fuit sa famille abusive pour trouver refuge auprès du père qu'elle n'a jamais connu. Tout ce qu'elle souhaite, c'est être en sécurité, mais son père, le redoutable duc Asterian, a d'autres projets... offrir à sa fille perdue depuis longtemps une famille aimante et un foyer merveilleux! Désormais, Tiel est déterminée à protéger sa famille des forces maléfiques qui veulent l'emmener loin d'elle. Parviendra-t-elle à combattre ces ennemis pour sauver son nouveau foyer? Ou Tiel perdra-t-elle ses proches une fois pour toutes?
___
L'histoire d'une petite léopard des neiges hybride qui a été maltraitée et négligée par son grand-père maternel parce qu'elle n'a pas réussi à éveiller la capacité unique de la famille. Elle meurt et est renvoyée dans le passé avec des souvenirs de sa vie antérieure. Confrontée au choix de subir les mêmes abus ou de rechercher son père, qui la déteste soi-disant, elle choisit la deuxième option, espérant une protection jusqu'à sa majorité. À sa grande surprise, son père, qu'elle croyait méprisé, se montre gentil et protecteur. Ses frères aînés, qui semblaient intimidants au premier abord, prennent également soin d'elle, et son grand-père paternel, qui semblait autrefois distant, envisage de lui transmettre de manière inattendue le leadership familial. La jeune fille commence à se rendre compte que sa famille, qu'elle pensait autrefois la rejeter, l'aime en fait.
___
Tiel est née d’un amour interdit entre les héritiers de deux clans ennemis depuis des millénaires: les Léopards des Neiges, au pouvoir de la glace, et les Léopards Noirs, au pouvoir du feu. À la mort tragique de sa mère lors de sa naissance, Tiel grandit au sein de sa famille maternelle. Mais, considérée comme une enfant illégitime et sans le moindre don, elle grandit isolée, rejetée et maltraitée, condamnée à porter la honte d’une union maudite. Alors qu’elle est sur le point de mourir de froid, elle est soudain ramenée dans le passé. Sans refuge, elle part vers la seule famille qu’il lui reste: celle de son père. On lui a toujours dit qu’elle y serait aussi rejetée, pourtant, peut-être n’y trouvera-t-elle pas que la cruauté qu’on lui a promise.

description.ko:
아기 설표는 사랑받고 싶어요
잡종으로 태어나 외할아버지에게 학대당하다가 죽었다.
내가 가문의 이능을 발현하지 못한 쓸모없는 아이였기 때문에.
    
기억을 가진 채 과거로 돌아왔지만, 선택지는 과거와 그리 다르지 않았다.
이대로 살다가 전생과 똑같이 학대당해 죽거나, 나를 끔찍하게 싫어하는 아빠를 찾아가거나.
    
'다시 죽는 건 싫어.'
    
결국 나는 나를 끔찍하게 증오한다는 아빠를 찾아갔다.
흑표 가문의 딸이라는 걸 증명할 수 있는 로켓 하나를 손에 꼭 쥐고서.
    
"제가……, 제가 여기서 지낼 수 있게 해 주세요."
    
내가 요청한 건 성년이 될 때까지의 보호.
혼자 살 수 있는 나이가 되면 폐 끼치지 않고 나가서 살 생각이었다.
나는 아무짝에도 쓸모없는 아이였으니까.
    
그런데…….
    
"사랑하는 내 딸, 너를 건드리는 놈이 있다면 당장 그놈의 숨통을 끊어 버릴 거다."
    
나를 싫어하는 줄 알았던 아빠는 내게 너무 상냥하고,
    
"야, 페르디. 너 자꾸 티엘 번쩍번쩍 안지 말라고. 요맘때 여자애들은 아주 섬세하게 대해 줘야 한다고 했단 말이야."
"그 멍청한 이론은 또 어디서 배웠어? 티엘은 안아 주는 걸 좋아해."
    
무섭다고 생각했던 두 오라버니들은 나를 너무 좋아하는 데다.
    
"티엘, 네게 이 흑표 가문의 가주직을 넘길 생각이다."
    
친할아버지는 갑자기 내게 가주직을 넘긴다고 한다.
    
저기…… 다들 저 싫어하시는 거 아니었어요?
description.pl: Urodziłam się jako hybryda i byłam torturowana przez dziadka aż do śmierci. Wszystko dlatego, że byłam bezużytecznym dzieckiem, które nie potrafiło przejawiać zdolności rodziny. Z nienaruszonymi wspomnieniami cofnąłem się w czasie, ale moje opcje nie różniły się zbytnio od poprzednich. Mogłam albo żyć tak jak wcześniej, być torturowana i umierać tak jak w poprzednim życiu, albo udać się do ojca, który mnie nienawidził. „Nie chcę znowu umierać”. W końcu poszłam do ojca, który bardzo mnie nienawidził. Ściskając żeton, który mógł udowodnić moje pochodzenie z Klanu Czarnego Lamparta, stanęłam przed nim. "Proszę... Proszę, pozwól mi tu zostać". Prosiłam o ochronę, dopóki nie dorosnę. Gdy będę wystarczająco dorosła, by żyć na własną rękę, planowałam odejść, nie będąc ciężarem. W końcu byłam bezużytecznym dzieckiem, ale wtedy... Mój dziadek nagle oświadczył, że przekazuje mi tytuł głowy rodziny. Czekaj... Czy oni wszyscy mnie nie nienawidzili?

Я вернулась в прошлое со своими воспоминаниями, но мои возможности не сильно отличались от прошлых.
Либо я буду жить так же и подвергаться насилию, как и в прошлой жизни, либо отправлюсь к отцу, который меня ненавидит.

Tudo o que ela quer é segurança, mas seu pai, o temido Duque Asterian, tem outros planos... dar à filha perdida uma família amorosa e um lar maravilhoso! Agora, Tiel está determinada a proteger sua nova família das forças malignas que querem levá-la embora. Será que ela conseguirá enfrentar esses inimigos para salvar seu novo lar? Ou perderá seus entes queridos de uma vez por todas?

Странная личность, этот тиран

Бац! Ривьер точно ударила Крофта в живот.

"If I die after eating, that’ll be great!" Luana was born an abandoned princess of a kingdom that would soon be occupied. "There was nothing I wanted in this small kingdom, but now I think I do.” Why are you looking at me when you say that~?!!! The story of Legion, the occupier of the kingdom who lost his sense of taste due to the curse, and Luana, the only person who could make him taste food.

---
“Are you eating in this situation?”

“Of course! I’ll have to keep savoring the taste until I die. Do you want one?”

She was reincarnated in a novel as Luana, the abandoned princess. And her death was already decided. She just wanted to let people know about her cooking talent, but she was misunderstood as a witch because of her cheese jerky!

The General of the conquering army, Duke Legion, who had lost his sense of taste, took her to the Empire for her extraordinary jerkies and to break the curse that had come down from generation to generation.

“It is delicious, isn’t it?”

“Prepare the same for the dinner.”

She was happy to be able to cook and eat as much as delicious food as she wanted… But now, she also wanted to look after Legion.

‘Eat three meals a day, and make sure to make dessert. I’m sure he will be able to gain some weight…!’

–

The Duke took the jerky from the princess. On the surface, it was no different from any beef jerky. But when he took a bite of it, it felt like a new world had opened up. The jerky, made by the princess, felt more tender than the others as he gently crushed it with his teeth. The taste of condensed meat smudged his tongue as he chewed on. It was just as she said. He could feel the savory taste of the spicy meat, and at the end of the day, he wanted to have more. The desire that he had, faded for a while.

“I didn’t really want anything, but now I think I do.”

description.en:
Lena Cornelli was executed along with her husband, whose rebellion failed. She reincarnated as "Asha Bliss", a side character who was a mage in a novel she enjoyed reading.

While she was living as quiet as a mouse without tampering with the original novel, she was commissioned by "Kaligo Etos", the strongest person in the Karahan Empire as well as the male lead of the novel, for an aphrodisiac one day.

"Kaligo, what are you doing here?"

Her surprise at the familiar face only lasted for a moment—

"May I touch you like this?"

In contrast to the previous indifference, he got straight to the point without fear. What in the world happened to her once austere and indifferent ex husband? Their marriage was awful in their previous life, but could it be different in this one?

description.de: Als Ellisa ihre Augen öffnet und in das Gesicht ihres jungen Sohnes Leon sieht, das voller Liebe und Sorge auf sie herabblickt, wird ihr klar, dass sie durch irgendein Wunder eine zweite Chance erhalten hat. In ihrem vergangenen Leben dachte sie, sie könne Leons Sicherheit nur gewährleisten, indem sie ihn zum Kaiser macht. Wenn sie aber gewusst hätte, dass Leon die Krone überhaupt nicht will und er sich das Leben nehmen würde, wenn ihm die Krone, getränkt mit dem Blut seiner Freunde und Feinde, präsentiert wird, dann hätte Ellisa einen anderen Weg gefunden, ihren Sohn zu beschützen. In diesem Leben ist sie fest entschlossen, eine Möglichkeit zu finden, um sowohl Leons Überleben als auch sein Glück zu bewahren... denn dieses Mal wird alles anders.
description.en:
When Ellisa opens her eyes and sees her young son, Leon, staring at her with eyes full of love and concern, she realizes that, by some miracle, she’s been given a second chance. In her past life, she thought making Leon emperor was the only way to ensure his safety. But if she had known Leon had never wanted the crown, or that laying a crown soaked with the blood of his enemies and beloved ones at his feet would mean he would take his own life before her eyes, she would’ve found another way. In this life, Ellisa is determined to find a way that will ensure both Leon’s survival and happiness. This time, things will be different.

---

description.fr: Lorsqu’Ellisa se réveille et aperçoit son jeune fils, Leon, l’observer avec des yeux remplis d’amour et de tendresse, elle comprend qu’on lui a miraculeusement accordé une seconde chance. Dans sa vie passée, elle croyait que pousser son fils à devenir empereur était le seul moyen de garantir sa sécurité. Mais si elle avait su que Leon n’avait jamais voulu monter sur le trône ou que déposer à ses pieds une couronne imbibée du sang de ses ennemis et de ses proches signifierait qu’il s’ôterait la vie sous ses yeux, elle aurait trouvé une autre solution. Dans cette vie, Ellisa est déterminée à trouver un moyen qui assurera la survie et le bonheur de Leon. Cette fois, ce sera différent!

description.ko:
"왜 이렇게 돼 버린 걸까? 내가 할 수 있는 모든 걸 다 했는데."

아들 레온을 황제로 만들기 위해 자신의 모든 걸 바친 엘리사.
은염의 마녀라 불리며 잔혹한 짓을 스스럼없이 저질렀다.

그런 피로 가득한 날들이 지나 염원하던 레온이 황제가 되던 날,
레온은 자살을 택한다.
태어나 단 한 번도 행복한 적 없었다며 죽어가는 레온을 보며 절망하던 엘리사.
갑작스러운 폭발 후 눈을 떠보니 과거로 회귀했다.

내 앞에 있는 6살의 레온... 차갑게 식어 가던 체온과 비교하면, 이 온기는 얼마나 사랑스러운가?

"이게 꿈이 아니라면, 나에게 기적처럼 새로운 기회가 주어진 거라면,
널 위한다는 이유로 많은 걸 빼앗겼던 네게 이번만큼은 원하는 걸 모두 이루어주고 싶다."
description.uk:
Вона віддала все, щоб зробити свого сина, третього принца Леона, імператором. У день, коли ця мрія здійснилася, її син отруїв сам себе.
«Я... ніколи в житті не був щасливим».
Для Еліші, яка тримала холодний труп свого сина, залишався лише відчай. «Леон…»
Однак, втративши свідомість, вона прокинулась і виявила, що її маленький син знову мило дивиться на неї!
«Якщо це не сон, якщо це нова можливість… Я зроблю все заради тебе».
Еліша, яка поклялася стати доброю матір’ю в цьому житті, замість того, щоб залишати за собою трупи, претендуючи на імператорський престол, робить інший вибір, об'єднуючись зі своїм пасинком, наслідним принцом.
description.vi:
Nhị Hoàng Hậu Elisa đã dành trọn kiếp trước để đưa con trai Leon lên ngai vàng.

Dùng mọi thủ đoạn tàn nhẫn, hy sinh những người cô yêu quý, quay lưng với đau khổ và oán hận của chính Leon, bởi cô tin ngôi vị Hoàng Đế là cách duy nhất để bảo vệ con trai mình.

Thế nhưng, thứ Leon cần không phải là Hoàng vị. Chỉ đến khi con trai tự sát trên ngai vàng, Elisa mới hiểu được điều ấy. 

Sống lại thêm một lần nữa, đối diện với đôi mắt trẻ thơ đầy lo lắng của Leon, Elisa quyết định sẽ thay đổi số mệnh của họ.

Lần này, nhất định đích đến sẽ là hạnh phúc.

description.en:
Agnes Saint is a princess with a reputation for cruelty and an unhealthy obsession with the dashing Captain Raymond. But when her personality changes overnight, it baffles everyone around her. The secret? The soul of a fangirl replaced Agnes in the middle of the story. Now, fueled by a stan’s unslakable love, she’s turned her eye to Kylo Grey, a side character with humble origins and her number one bias. Can she rewrite Agnes’ story to ship herself with the man of her dreams?
___
I’ve been reincarnated into a novel with my living and breathing bias.
Now I’m an Imperial Princess, who is known by all sorts of epithets, Agnes Saint!

It’s great that she’s filthy rich and a royal and all, but there’s just one problem…
the hateful trash who just insulted by bias’s very existence is none other than ‘me.’

Regardless, I’m here now and…
I will do anything, and everything, within my power to prevent my bias’s death and ensure he experiences nothing but smooth sailing going forward!

I would never wish for Kylo, my kitten, to suffer any sort of shock.
That’s why I have to hide my fervent adoration.
Besides, nothing good would come from revealing my stanning anyways.
So, for the time being, I’ll be perfect at… 

‘stanning in secret.’
description.es: Una ávida lectora de la novela “Splash infinito” muere atropellada por un “error de sistema”, según le informa una diosa. Para compensarla por el pequeño descuido, le ofrece una nueva vida en cualquier mundo que ella desee, real o ficticio. Sin pensarlo dos veces, la lectora sabe exactamente lo que quiere: conocer a su personaje favorito de “Splash infinito”, Kylo Grey. Pero, obviamente, renace como el personaje que peor relación tiene con Kylo, la princesa Agnes Saint. Para colmo, Agnes tiene una reputación espantosa en todo el imperio. Nuestra lectora tiene un doble desafío frente a ella: rectificar su mala fama de a poco para no levantar sospechas y, además, hacer todo lo posible para mejorar su relación con Kylo y vivir el tórrido romance que siempre se ha imaginado. ¿Lo logrará?
description.fr: Agnès Saint est une princesse connue pour sa cruauté et son obsession maladive pour le fringant Capitaine Raymond. Mais lorsqu’elle change soudainement de personnalité du jour au lendemain, tout le monde autour d’elle est déconcerté. Son secret ? L’âme d’une fangirl a pris la place d’Agnès en plein milieu de l’histoire. Désormais guidée par un amour inébranlable de fan, elle jette son dévolu sur Kaylo, un personnage secondaire aux origines modestes et son coup de cœur ultime. Parviendra-t-elle à réécrire l’histoire d’Agnès pour se mettre en couple avec l’homme de ses rêves ?
description.id: Seorang fangirl garis keras karakter villain bernama Kylo Gray masuk ke cerita yang disukainya! Namun, saat tersadar, kenapa dia malah menampar Kylo? Terlebih, berkali-kali?! Ternyata dia terlahir kembali sebagai karakter yang membenci Kylo, Agnes Saint. Apa yang akan dilakukan fans nomor satu Kylo ini pada takdir barunya?
description.ko:
최애가 살아 숨 쉬는 소설로 환생했다.
각종 수식어로 불리는 제국의 황녀, 아그네스 세인트로!

최애의 인격을 모독하던 혐성 쓰레기가 바로 '나'라는 게 문제였다.

그래도 이왕 이렇게 된 이상...
기필코, 반드시, 어떻게 해서든 최애의 죽음을 막고 그 앞에 꽃길을 깔아주겠다!

나만의 아기 고양이, 카일로가 놀라는 건 결코 원하지 않았다.
그러려면 이 애끓는 마음을 당분간은 숨겨야만 한다.
게다가 원래 덕질을 밝혀서 좋은 건 없다. 그러니 당분간은 완벽하게...

'일코'한다.
description.ru:
Переродиться в романе, где живет мой любимый персонаж.
Самая красивая женщина континента. Любимая драгоценность императора. Королева светского общества. Бомба замедленного действия.
Я стала принцессой Агнес Сеинт, которую и называют всеми этими титулами и именами. Приятно быть частью богатой королевской семьи, но…
Как Драко Малфой, презирающий магглов в Гарри Поттере, так и «я» была ненормальной стервой, которая оскорбила моего любимого персонажа. И что еще хуже — она безнадежно влюблена в другого мужчину.
«Мой любимчик — Кайл, соперник главного героя, чьей ненормальной фанаткой я и переродилась…»
Но теперь, когда все в моих руках… Я любой ценой, любыми способами предотвращу смерть моего любимого персонажа и застелю его путь цветами! Но если бы я вдруг раскрыла себя как фанатка Кайла, все бы решили, что я сошла с ума. Он бы посчитал, что я чокнутая! Я вовсе не хочу, чтобы мой котенок был так шокирован. Поэтому пока что я должна скрывать свою мучительную привязанность. Тем более, что раскрытие того, что вы фанат, никогда не заканчивается ничем хорошим. Поэтому на данный момент идеально будет… «Держать все в тайне».

Betrayed and killed by his fellow Ninestar guild members, the powerful necromancer Cha Jin-Hyuk resorts to a daring soul transference.

A decade later, he awakens in a new body, devoid of his former powers. With the support of his new comrades, Spirit Master Balkan and hobgoblin Haryu, he embarks on a quest for vengeance, scaling the mysterious tower once again.

description.en:
After dying in an experiment, Anisha wakes up in the past at the orphanage where she was sold to a mad scientist. However, things take a different path when she is adopted by Duke Aubrey to replace his late daughter, Annette. Though having to live as someone else, she decides to enjoy her new freedom while plotting revenge on the scientist. But as she starts to recall facts unknown in her former life, Anisha wonders if it's a side effect of the experiments or if her past holds deeper secrets…
___
I thought I had regressed from this ragged life, but why has my time-limited life remained the same?
I'm ruined... is this how I should live my life...?

"This time, I'll get adopted by a normal family, and live in comfort for the rest of my life!"

Step by step, I'm going to take revenge against the one behind my death, and I'll protect what's left of my small and precious life!

However, did I put in too much effort?

"Anisha, you're perfect."

"I'm going to make this child a future professor."

All I wanted was to survive...

"Well, somehow, you’ve passed. I'll have to adopt this brat."

I ended up with a tycoon I didn't expect.
One whose household will be massacred in a few years!

How do I know that?
Me too! I didn't want to! Know that!

But what can I do? The milk has already been spilt.
I'll just live in bliss while acting as the real daughter during my 5 years contract, then I'll leave!

However...

"...I happened to pick this up on the way home."
"Father, you're the best!"
"I know."

...Something's wrong.

"I checked this out 'myself', and inspected it 'in person'. There's nothing to be grateful for."
"Father, you're a genius!"
"I know this too."

No, well, something's REALLY wrong.

**

I became fond of this unique and strange family, but...

"The five years contract we signed,"
"Let's nullify it."

While looking straight into my eyes, dad announced the termination.

"I can help you, but you'll still die anyway."

Not only that,
But death came under my nose too.

Will I be able to survive?
description.ko:
"거지 같은 삶에서 회귀한 줄 알았는데, 시한부 인생은 그대로라고?
망할, 이게 인생이냐….

'이번엔 적당한 가문에 입양 가서 남은 인생 편히 살자!'

겸사겸사 날 죽게 한 원흉에게 복수도 하고
작고 소중한, 남은 인생만이라도 지켜보는 거야!

하지만, 너무 최선을 다했던 걸까?

""아니샤, 너는 완벽하구나.""
""이 애는 내가 다음 선생님 후보로 삼아야겠어.""

난 그저 살고 싶었던 것뿐인데…

“뭐, 그럭저럭 합격이다. 이 녀석을 입양하지.”

예상치 못한 거물을 물어버렸다.
그것도 몇 년 뒤에 온 집안이 몰살당하는 썩은 동아줄을!

그걸 어떻게 알았냐고?
나도! 알고 싶지! 않았다!
이런 어린 시절로 되돌아오지만 않았다면 말이다!

하지만, 이미 엎어진 물을 어쩌겠어.
이렇게 된 이상 5년의 계약 기간 동안
진짜 딸의 대역 노릇이나 하며 꿀이나 빨다가 떠나는 거야!

그런데…….

“……우연히 오다 주웠다.”
“아버지 최고!”
“안다.”

……뭔가 좀 이상하다.

“이건 내가 ‘직접’ 둘러보고 ‘친히’ 시찰까지 갔지만, 딱히 고마워할 건 없다.”
“아버지 천재!”
“그것도 알아.”

아니, 좀 많이 이상하다.

**

이 독특하고 이상한 가족에 막 정이 들려는 때,

“너와 내가 맺었던 5년짜리 계약.”
“이만 해지하자꾸나.”

아빠가 나를 직시하며 끝을 고했다.

“도와줄 순 있는데, 그래도 너 죽을 거야.”

그뿐이랴,
죽음은 코앞까지 다가왔다. 

나, 무사히 살아남을 수 있을까?"
description.tr: Hayatımın bu harap halinden kurtulduğumu düşündüm ama neden sınırlı zamanlı hayatım aynı kaldı? Mahvoldum… Gerçekten böyle mi yaşamalıyım…? ‘Bu sefer normal bir aile tarafından evlat edinilip geri kalan hayatımı huzur içinde yaşayacağım!’ Adım adım, ölümümün arkasındaki kişiye intikam alacak ve küçük ve değerli hayatımın geri kalanını koruyacağım! Ama fazla mı çaba harcadım? ‘Anisha, mükemmelsin.’ ‘Bu çocuğu gelecekte bir profesör yapacağım.’ Tek istediğim hayatta kalmaktı… ‘Neyse ki, bir şekilde geçtin. Bu yaramazı evlat edinmek zorundayım.’ Beklemediğim bir şekilde tycoon(lider)’la karşılaştım. Birkaç yıl içinde soyunun kıyımına uğrayacak biri! Bunu nasıl biliyorum? Ben de istemedim! Bunu nasıl biliyorum!
description.zh: 重生后又回到悲惨童年，幸运地是被一个大人物收养了！ 不过这个家族几年后就会灭亡…既然已经覆水难收。 那就在有限的生命里，好好享受一番再走！ 可是，这个合约养父也太恶毒挑剔了吧！嘿嘿，随着我越来越熟练地扮演乖乖女鹅，这个爸爸似乎已经彻底被我征服却不自知了呢？
description.pt-br: Eu pensei que tinha regredido desta vida irregular, mas por que minha vida limitada por tempo permaneceu a mesma? Estou arruinado... é assim que devo viver minha vida...? “Desta vez, serei adotado por uma família normal e viverei com conforto pelo resto da minha vida!” Passo a passo, vou me vingar daquele que está por trás da minha morte e protegerei o que resta da minha pequena e preciosa vida! No entanto, eu me esforcei demais? “Anisha, você é perfeita.” “Vou fazer desta criança um futuro professor.” Tudo que eu queria era sobreviver... “Bem, de alguma forma, você passou. Vou ter que adotar esse pirralho.” Acabei com um magnata que não esperava. Alguém cuja família será massacrada em alguns anos! Como posso saber disso? Eu também! Eu não queria! Saiba disso!

description.en:
Q: Describe your feelings upon discovering your trusted dad isn’t just an extra.
A: W-what the heck... Give me back my ‘Random Imperial Citizen #1’ life...

Living in a world of constant war—365 days of chaos—a simple, extra's existence was a blessing.
At least, that's what I thought.

In a small village, I enjoyed a humble life with my loving, ordinary father, James Brown, 27, the epitome of an unremarkable single dad.

Or so I believed.

“Ladies and gentlemen, presenting my father! The quintessential symbol of extras everywhere! Brown hair, brown eyes, plain and simple!”
“...”
“This man screams ‘background character,’ living a quiet life chopping wood in a mountain village with his adorable daughter. Right? ...RIGHT?”

The knight commander merely stared at me in silence.

And then, the unthinkable happened.

Behind me, my father’s worn staff began to glow with a strange, blue aura.

“...Dad?”

Before I could process what was happening, his unassuming brown hair and eyes shifted. Slowly but surely, they transformed into...

Shimmering silver locks and piercing blue eyes—practically shouting “I’m the protagonist!”

“WHAT?!”

My simple, extra life shattered into a million pieces as my dad—no, this mysterious powerhouse—gripped his weapon and snarled:
“Give me back my daughter, you bastard.”

---
Deserting the battlefield, Enoch Rubinstein flees with his newborn daughter Lilith to a small village to raise her disguised as James Brown, a regular, doting single father. But when the order of knights returns to drag Enoch back to the capital, Lilith finds that her father was secretly one of the empire's greatest heroes. As her father's daughter, she also discovers that she holds great potential. Will Lilith be able to keep her family safe? Or will the secrets lurking ahead overpower her?
description.es:
Q. Describe cómo te sentiste al descubrir que el padre en el que confiabas no era un extra.

R. ¿Q-Qué es esto? Devuélvanme mi rol de ‘Ciudadana del Imperio 1’… ¡365 días de guerra al año!

Un mundo completamente desquiciado, donde no hay ni un solo día de paz. Haber nacido como un extra en este lugar era una auténtica bendición.

-Princesa, despierte ya~♡

-Ah, pero qué bonita es mi hija~♡♡

Además, vivir una vida tranquila en un pueblo remoto con un padre increíble y amable (James Brown, 27 años, extra)… ¡Era lo mejor que me podía pasar! O al menos eso pensaba… Ahora, fíjense bien, ¡el caballero que ven aquí es mi padre! ¡Un hombre cualquiera de clase plebeya, con cabello y ojos marrones, el típico ‘Ciudadano del Imperio 1’! … Lo mires por donde lo mires, no es más que un humilde aldeano que sobrevive cortando leña para comer. ¡Un padre soltero de 27 años que cría solo a su pequeña hija en este pueblo apartado! El capitán de los caballeros solo me miraba con una expresión indiferente.

-Ehh… ¿Señor? Esto… ¿Hola? ¡¿Qué está pasando aquí?!

En ese momento, el capitán retrocedió un paso y desenvainó su espada. Por instinto, me giré para ver qué ocurría.

-‘¿Papá…?’

Una energía azulada comenzaba a brillar en el viejo bastón de mi padre. Me froté los ojos y miré de nuevo.

-‘¿Qué demonios es eso?’

Y entonces… El símbolo de ‘extra’ que era el cabello marrón y los ojos marrones de mi padre empezó a cambiar… ¿Eh? Transformándose en un radiante cabello plateado y unos ojos azules que parecían decir, ‘¡Soy el protagonista!’ ‘Oye, oye… Un padre soltero de 27 años que vive con su hija en un pueblo remoto…’ ¿James…? ¿Esto es en serio? ‘Devuélveme a mi hija, maldito bastardo.’
description.fr: Décrivez vos sentiments lorsque vous découvrez que votre père de confiance n'est pas juste un figurant. R : Q-c'est quoi ce bordel... Rendez-moi ma vie de « Citoyen Impérial au Hasard #1 »... Vivre dans un monde de guerre constante - 365 jours de chaos - l'existence d'un simple figurant était une bénédiction. Du moins, c'est ce que je pensais. Dans un petit village, j'ai vécu une vie humble avec mon père aimant et ordinaire, James Brown, 27 ans, l'incarnation d'un père célibataire sans particularité. Du moins, c'est ce que je croyais. « Mesdames et messieurs, je vous présente mon père ! Le symbole par excellence des figurants partout ! Cheveux bruns, yeux bruns, tout simplement ! » « ... » « Cet homme crie « personnage de fond », menant une vie tranquille à couper du bois dans un village de montagne avec son adorable fille. N'est-ce pas ? ... N'EST-CE PAS ? » Le chevalier commandant me regarda simplement en silence. Et puis, l'impensable se produisit. Derrière moi, le bâton usé de mon père commença à briller d'une étrange aura bleue. « ... Papa ? » Avant que je puisse comprendre ce qui se passait, ses cheveux bruns et ses yeux modestes se sont transformés. Lentement mais sûrement, ils se sont transformés en… des boucles argentées scintillantes et des yeux bleus perçants, criant pratiquement « Je suis le protagoniste ! » « QUOI ?! » Ma vie simple et supplémentaire s'est brisée en un million de morceaux lorsque mon père – non, cette mystérieuse centrale électrique – a saisi son arme et a grogné : « Rends-moi ma fille, salaud. »
description.ko:
Q. 믿었던 아빠가 엑스트라가 아닐 때의 심정을 서술하시오.
A. 뭐, 뭐야…. 내 ‘지나가던 제국민 1’ 역할 돌려줘요….

1년 365일 전쟁 중!
하루라도 바람 잘 날 없는 미친 세계관!
이곳에서 엑스트라로 태어났다는 건 축복이었다.

“공주~ 일어나세용♡”
“아고, 이뻐라 울 딸♡♡”

게다가 멋지고 다정한 아빠(제임스 브라운, 27세, 엑스트라)와 산골 마을에서 오순도순 살아가는 소박한 삶이라니, 최고다!

……라고 생각했는데.

= = =

“자, 그럼 보시져! 마침 등장한 저분이 바로! 제 아버지입니다! 널리고 널린 평민 남자들의 상징, 갈색 머리와 갈색 눈!”
“…….”
“요, 요리 보고 조리 봐도 지나가는 제국민 1에 불과하져. 산골 마을에서 어린 딸과 힘들게 나무 해서 먹고 사는 27살 미혼부예요.”

기사단장은 무심한 표정으로 나를 쳐다볼 뿐이었다.

“…저어, 선생님? 저기여? 으앙!”

그 순간, 기사단장이 흠칫하며 검을 빼 들었다.
나는 본능적으로 돌아보았다.

‘…아빠?’

아빠의 낡은 부지깽이 위로 푸른 기운이 일렁이고 있었다.
나는 눈을 비비고 다시 보았다.

‘저, 저게 뭐야?’

다음 순간.
엑스트라 1의 상징이었던 아빠의 갈색 머리와 갈색 눈이….
서서히 바뀌었다.

“헐.”

누가 봐도 ‘나 주인공이야!’ 하고 외치는 눈부신 은발과 번뜩이는 푸른 눈동자로!

‘저, 저기요? 홀로 어린 딸을 키우는 산골 마을 27세 미혼부….’

……제임스 씨? 이거 맞나요?

“내 딸 내놔, 이 개자식아.”
description.ru:
В: Расскажите о своих чувствах, когда выясняется, что ваш папа – не второстепенный персонаж.
О: Ч-что происходит... Верните мне роль "Обычного имперского гражданина №1"...

Мир в состоянии вечной войны!
Сумасшедший мир без единого спокойного дня!
Быть фоновым персонажем здесь – настоящая удача.

– Принцесса~ Просыпайся, милая♡
– Ах, какая же ты красавица, доченька♡

А уж мирная жизнь в горной деревне с прекрасным и любящим папой (Джеймс Браун, 27 лет, массовка) – просто предел мечтаний!
Так я думала раньше...

– Смотрите! Вот он, мой отец! Типичный представитель простого народа с каштановыми волосами и карими глазами!
– ...
– Куда ни глянь – обычный прохожий. Отец-одиночка, 27 лет, живущий в горной деревушке и зарабатывающий на жизнь сбором дров вместе с маленькой дочерью.

Командир рыцарей лишь равнодушно смотрел на меня.

– Эм... господин? Эй? Ой!

В этот момент командир вздрогнул и обнажил меч.
Я инстинктивно обернулась.

– Папа?..

Над старой папиной палкой пульсировала синяя энергия.
Я протёрла глаза и взглянула снова.

– Ч-что это такое?

В следующее мгновение каштановые волосы и карие глаза отца, признак обычного второстепенного персонажа... Начали трансформироваться.

– Не верю своим глазам.

В сияющие серебряные волосы и пронзительные голубые глаза, кричащие "Я – протагонист!"

– Простите? Одинокий отец из горной деревушки, 27 лет, воспитывающий дочь в одиночку...
Мистер Джеймс?.. Это действительно вы?

– Отдай мне мою дочь, ублюдок.
description.tr: Bir köyde sıradan bir hayat süren küçük kız, babasının yalnızca sıradan bir yan karakter olduğunu düşünür. The man she accidentally spent a night with was a formerly wolf-eared idol?!

"A three room apartment in the metropolitan area + a foreign car + retirement with guaranteed pension and savings." That was the dream goal of 29-year-old pharmacist Han Sooji, who used to be a passionate fan of the idol group LUPUS back in her school days. However, due to several problems and a member’s departure, the group was forced to disband. Her young heart was scarred as she thought her steamy dreams were over, but…? LUPUS's former member, as well as the leading cause of the disbandment, is now getting ready to return to the entertainment world. After meeting Kim Beomchan, aka Jackie, and spending a bewildering night together, she promised to be a reliable friend. She also learned about LUPUS's unfortunately troubling past from the former members.

---
As a teen, Sooji was heartbroken when her favorite idol group LUPUS disbanded, thanks to the traitorous member Jackie quitting. Ten years later, Sooji has become a workaholic pharmacist who just wants a stable, predictable life. But she's thrown for a loop when she suddenly runs into Jackie—at an animal shelter, of all places! After learning that he plans to return to showbiz, Sooji is enraged and picks a fight with him... starting a deep dive into the untold ups and downs of LUPUS and it members. What really happened behind the scenes to Jackie all those years ago, and can Sooji, now along for the ride, survive his path back to stardom?

그곳에서 불행히도 많은 이들을 공포에 떨게 한 괴물의 빙결 능력을 갖게 되어 끝내 절망한 발레리는 19살 생일에 스스로 죽음을 택하지만 죽음 속에서 눈을 떠보니 앨리시아에게 학대받던 9살의 어린 시절로 돌아왔다는 것을 깨닫게 되는데….
발레리는 과거와 달라지기 위해 자신을 설산으로 유배시킨 황제이자 이복 오빠인 밀러드에게로 도망치고,

“폐하. 제발 저를 구해주세요! 시키시는 건 뭐든 다 할게요. 제발, 저 좀 살려주세요….”

그날을 기점으로 발레리의 삶은 과거와 달라지게 된다.
그리고 소중한 가족들과 행복한 나날들을 보내던 발레리는 세상과 단절된 채 능력을 숨기고 살아가는 어둠 속의 아이를 만난다.

“안녕, 괴물.”
“나도 너와 같은 괴물이야.”

description.en:
What would you do if you were reincarnated as one of the main protagonists in the romantic fantasy (“rom-fan”) novel you’ve been reading? 
Do everything in your power to keep the story on track and save the day to be crowned as empress? 
Make amends for all the treacherous things your villainous character did to change her fate of demise? 
Hone your magical powers and valiantly fight for the empire as a dashing imperial crown prince should? 
Umm, nah. When Yeonghui, Ji-eun, and Cheolsu find themselves in this predicament, they have other plans. Will their choices alter the course of this rom-fan world for good or for worse?

“I’m from the afterlife.” Lee Do-jin needs money—a lot of it—to cover his younger sibling’s medical bills. With nowhere else to turn, he calls the number on a strange, ominous business card he finds by chance. At the meeting point, he encounters a silver-haired woman shrouded in mystery— a grim reaper, known as a Chasa. She makes him an unbelievable offer: Work as a temp worker for the Underworld. His mission? To stop “Mokdugi,” predators that feast on souls tainted by sin, before they can drag the damned into chaos. Thrust into the supernatural world of death, debt, and spiritual battles, Do-jin must navigate his new double life— balancing his humanity with a job that demands he walk the line between life and death.
description.pt-br: "Eu sou do além." Lee Do-jin precisa de muito dinheiro para pagar as despesas médicas da irmã mais nova. Sem ter a quem mais recorrer, ele liga para o número de um cartão de visitas estranho e sinistro que encontra por acaso. No local combinado, ele se depara com uma mulher misteriosa de cabelos prateados — uma ceifadora, conhecida como Chasa. Ela lhe faz uma proposta inacreditável: trabalhar temporariamente para o Mundo Inferior. Sua missão? Impedir os "Mokdugi", predadores que se alimentam de almas corrompidas pelo pecado, antes que arrastem os condenados ao caos. Jogado no mundo sobrenatural da morte, dívidas e batalhas espirituais, Do-jin precisa lidar com essa nova vida dupla — conciliando sua humanidade com um trabalho que o obriga a caminhar na fronteira entre a vida e a morte.

Nadia couldn't agree more with his opinion.
Thank you, Marquis, be sure to keep your word.

“The Marquis said you had no intention of sleeping with me.”
“… … .”
“So, to ensure an heir, there's no other choice but to take a concubine... … .”

Nadia's head jerked at the sound of something crushing on her.
Then, out of the corner of her eyes, she saw that the table her husband was working on had cracked.

No, why did it suddenly break?
description.ko:
“내 아내로 인정받을 망상 따위 꿈에도 하지 않는 게 좋을 거다. 내가 발라지트의 딸에게서 후사를 볼 일은 영영 없을 테니.”

나디아는 하마터면 나도 같은 생각이라고 맞장구칠 뻔했다.

감사합니다, 후작놈아.
자기 입으로 한 말은 꼭 지키세요.

***

“후작님께서 저와 합방을 할 의사가 없다고 하셨거든요.”
“…….”
“그러니 후계를 위해선 어쩔 수 없이 첩을 들이는 수밖에…….”

콰직.
무언가 으스러지는 소리에 나디아의 고개가 홱 돌아갔다.
그러자 남편이 짚은 테이블의 한 구석에 금이 간 모습이 보인다.

아니, 저게 갑자기 왜 부서져?

Dziękuję ci, markizie. Mam nadzieję, że dotrzymasz swoich słów.

pęknięcie

W następnej chwili widzi, pęknięcie w rogu stołu, przy którym był jej mąż.
To znaczy, dlaczego ten stół nagle się złamał?
